name: Infinite Worlds
description: GURPS 4th Edition's own default campaign setting, loosely inspired by H. Beam Piper's Paratime stories. Homeline — a parallel Earth that cracked the technology of parachronic travel — quietly polices and explores an infinity of alternate timelines through Infinity Unlimited and the UN-backed I-Cops, while its rival power Centrum runs its own competing parachronics program. Player characters are typically Homeline agents: explorers, scouts, and troubleshooters stepping sideways into worlds where history went differently — a Rome that never fell, an America that stayed colonial, or somewhere stranger still.
